audit.description: Every command of the console, append-only

catalog.description: Plan versions and individual terms of subjects
catalog.pickVersion: Pick a plan version on the left

analyticsEventSetStatus.description: Block an event at ingest without a deploy (or switch it back on). Every client stops recording it within half a minute.
analyticsEventSetStatus.title: Block or enable an analytics event

analyticsRollupRebuild.description: Recalculate daily aggregates for a range of days — after a fix in the ingest or late events.
analyticsRollupRebuild.title: Rebuild analytics aggregates

analyticsUserForget.description: Erase the person’s raw usage events, device links and personal aggregates. Anonymous totals stay.
analyticsUserForget.title: Forget a person’s usage analytics

entitlementsGrantCreate.description: A gift, add-on or manual value for one key; merged with the plan by the key’s rule
entitlementsGrantCreate.title: Add a grant

entitlementsOverrideSet.description: Overrides the final value of one key for the subject until the given date; reason is mandatory
entitlementsOverrideSet.title: Set an individual term

entitlementsPlanCreateVersion.description: Copies the latest version of the plan into an editable draft
entitlementsPlanCreateVersion.title: New plan draft

entitlementsPlanPublishVersion.description: The version becomes immutable; subscribers of the plan get its values on the next read
entitlementsPlanPublishVersion.title: Publish a plan version

entitlementsSubscriptionSet.description: Pins the subject to a published version of a plan; no version — the subject falls to the free plan
entitlementsSubscriptionSet.title: Set a subscription

webhooksEndpointDisable.description: Deliveries to the address stop at once. Only the platform can enable it again; the owner and admins of the organization are notified.
webhooksEndpointDisable.title: Disable a webhook

webhooksEndpointEnable.description: The address is verified with a ping again and becomes active after a 2xx answer.
webhooksEndpointEnable.title: Enable a webhook disabled by the platform

keysBotFreeze.description: All keys of the bot stop working until the organization owner unfreezes it.
keysBotFreeze.title: Freeze a bot

keysKeyRevoke.description: The key stops working immediately; the owner and admins of the organization are notified.
keysKeyRevoke.title: Revoke an API key

keysRootRotate.description: Re-wrap every key version under the NEXT root. First the ceremony file is rolled out to every instance as KEYS_ROOT_KEY_FILE_NEXT; the command checks the fingerprint and the fleet, then re-wraps in the background in batches. When the job reports completion, make the new file KEYS_ROOT_KEY_FILE, remove the NEXT variable and restart every instance.
keysRootRotate.title: Rotate the root key

keysSigningCompromise.description: The version is rejected by archival signature verification forever, in any state. If it is the primary one, a new version becomes primary first. Artifacts signed by it must be re-attested by their owner (consent versions — the re-attest command).
keysSigningCompromise.title: Mark a signing version compromised

keysSigningRotate.description: New Ed25519 version for an audience: published in JWKS, activated after the cache window; the old one keeps verifying until the longest token expires.
keysSigningRotate.title: Rotate a signing key

keysWorkspaceFreeze.description: Kill-switch: every key of the organization is disabled — its encrypted data becomes unreadable and its bots stop at once. Nothing is deleted.
keysWorkspaceFreeze.title: Freeze the keys of an organization

keysWorkspaceRotateKek.description: New KEK version; rows are re-wrapped in the background.
keysWorkspaceRotateKek.title: Rotate the encryption key of an organization

keysWorkspaceUnfreeze.description: Re-enable the frozen keys of an organization.
keysWorkspaceUnfreeze.title: Unfreeze the keys of an organization

platformPiiReveal.description: Shows the full phone, IIN/BIN or address of a person or organization; every reveal is logged
platformPiiReveal.title: Reveal personal data

platformPolicySet.description: Four-eyes: high-risk commands go through a second staff member’s approval
platformPolicySet.title: Change the console policy

platformStaffAdd.description: Adds a person to the platform staff; without a role they see nothing
platformStaffAdd.title: Add a staff member

platformStaffRoleGrant.description: Separation of duties is checked: one person cannot both write and approve one object
platformStaffRoleGrant.title: Grant a role

platformStaffSuspend.description: Revokes all console sessions and blocks sign-in until reinstated
platformStaffSuspend.title: Suspend a staff member

keysBlindIndexRotate.description: Only when the blind index key is compromised. A new version fills the second index column in the background while sign-in and search keep working, then search switches to it and the old column is cleared.
keysBlindIndexRotate.title: Rotate the blind index key

consentsDocumentDraftSave.description: Create or update the single draft of a platform document in three languages. Publishing is a separate command.
consentsDocumentDraftSave.title: Save a document draft

consentsDocumentPublish.description: The draft becomes an immutable signed version with an effective date. Before the date — a notification and an “accept in advance” banner; from the date — a blocking screen. Publishing sooner than the notice period requires the urgent flag and a detailed reason.
consentsDocumentPublish.title: Publish a document version

consentsDocumentAttest.description: Sends the PDF imprint of the version (three languages and hashes) to the named person for an electronic digital signature. Optional: the platform signature is already in place.
consentsDocumentAttest.title: Certify a version with the head’s digital signature

consentsVersionsReattest.description: After a signing key is marked compromised: versions signed with it are checked against the hashes in people’s acceptance records and re-signed with the current key. The old signature stays in the history.
consentsVersionsReattest.title: Re-sign document versions

pdIncidentOpen.description: Registers a security breach. The deadline for notifying the authorised body — one business day from detection — is calculated at once; the owners are alerted now and 4 hours before the deadline.
pdIncidentOpen.title: Open a personal data incident

pdIncidentNotifyAuthority.description: Marks that the authorised body has been notified. State the outgoing number or the channel in the note.
pdIncidentNotifyAuthority.title: Record the notification of the authorised body

pdIncidentNotifySubjects.description: Marks that the affected people have been notified.
pdIncidentNotifySubjects.title: Record the notification of the data subjects

pdIncidentClose.description: Closes the incident. State the outcome and the measures taken in the note.
pdIncidentClose.title: Close the incident

idempotencyKeyLookup.title: Find by repeat key
idempotencyKeyLookup.description: An integrator asks whether their request went through: find its attempts by the repeat key. Response bodies are never shown

securitySessionRevoke.title: End sessions
securitySessionRevoke.description: Ends one session of the person or all of them: the devices sign out right away, access tokens stop working

securityAccountFreeze.title: Freeze the account
securityAccountFreeze.description: Closes sign-in, all sessions and personal API keys. Only the owner unfreezes it — with the password and an SMS code

securityAccountUnfreeze.title: Unfreeze the account
securityAccountUnfreeze.description: Only after the identity is checked by the support procedure. Also lifts the sign-in lockout

securityAlertClose.title: Close the alert
securityAlertClose.description: Closes a detection alert with a resolution; the evidence stays in the log

securityEventRevealIp.title: Show the IP address
securityEventRevealIp.description: Decrypts the full IP address of the event. The reveal itself is recorded in the log

securityDigestVerify.title: Verify log integrity
securityDigestVerify.description: Recomputes the digests signed in the window: rows, Merkle root, signature and the chain

securityExport.title: Export the security log
securityExport.description: The whole platform log for the window as a file for you; the export is recorded in the log

securityStreamReplay.title: Replay the SIEM stream
securityStreamReplay.description: Sends the organization security events of the window to its webhooks again

login.subtitle: Password first, then a code from SMS
login.title: Platform console

noAccess.text: This account is not on the platform staff, or it has been suspended.
noAccess.title: No access to the console

picker.placeholder: Find a person: phone, IIN, id or name

requests.description: Commands that wait for a second staff member

runner.idempotent: a double click is safe — the command runs once
runner.ticketPlaceholder: Support ticket or task reference, optional

search.description: A full phone number, a 12-digit IIN or BIN, an identifier or a name
search.emptyText: Type a full phone number, a 12-digit IIN or BIN, an identifier or at least three letters of a name
search.emptyTitle: Find a person or an organization
search.title: Search

securityEvents.soloDualControl: a two-person command ran alone (no second holder)
securityEvents.stepUpBurst: failed step-up passwords in a row
securityEvents.pdIncidentOpened: a personal data incident is opened
securityEvents.pdIncidentDeadline: less than 4 hours left to notify the authorised body of an incident
securityEvents.massExport: mass export of data by one actor
securityEvents.digestMismatch: the security log integrity is broken
securityEvents.idorProbing: probing of other people’s objects by one account
securityEvents.malwareBurst: a series of infected uploads by one account

shell.title: Platform console

staff.description: Who works in the console and with which roles

stepUp.subtitle: High-risk actions need a fresh confirmation: password and a code from SMS. The window lasts 15 minutes.
stepUp.title: Confirm the action

security.title: Security
security.description: The security log of the whole platform: events, console commands, detection alerts, integrity

integrity.digestsHint: Every few minutes the log is sealed with a signed Merkle root; a change of any row breaks the check.
integrity.partitionsHint: Three years in the database; before removal a month is exported to the archive with a signed manifest.
integrity.verifyOk: The log is intact: {digests, plural, one {# digest} other {# digests}}, {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
integrity.verifyFailed: Mismatch in {n, plural, one {# digest} other {# digests}} — an alert is raised
integrity.exportsHint: Files of the “Export the security log” command — only for you.

manifest.title: Archive manifest: {month}
manifest.hint: The file is read from the storage and checked against the signature saved in the database at export time: a swapped file fails the check.
manifest.notFound: The manifest is not in the storage

panel.openAlerts: {n, plural, one {# open alert} other {# open alerts}}

panel.streamOff: No SIEM stream on the plan
